_comment: Drift guard for audits/checks/b2-validate-robots.mjs. Lists the AI-crawler User-agent sections that src/pages/robots.txt.ts must preserve: training crawlers are blocked from the dashboard except /llms.txt, while search/answer agents are allowed to read the full site.
